name: pocketagents
description: Self-hosted mobile remote control for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity IDE, DeepSeek Harness (DSH), and WorkBuddy. Launch local QR pairing, approve commands from your phone, or deploy a 24/7 Hub.
suggestedPrompts: Start PocketAgents locally and show a QR code for my phone
Connect this machine to my 24/7 PocketAgents Cloud Hub
Check PocketAgents daemon health and mobile approval hook status
